entry_state: The portable packages preserve financial connections, immutable source versions and explicit partial coverage. The operation registry separates preparation, review, compilation and history construction; uncertainty evaluation has begun and continues on the next page.
exit_state: The operation registry preserves effects and closed record boundaries. Ordered EPS retains context, series completeness and exact comparison traces; company projection checks full books and daily share history without committing. The grammar appendix is next.
findings: The uncertainty evaluation entry actually ends on373; its admission and selection entries begin374. The saved entry forecast is corrected by viewing the continuation.
Accounting assessment and authorization cannot post; proposal includes an independent economic delta and commit is a separate atomic transaction.
Closed accounting records bind basis, authority, profile, view and book mode; synthetic evidence cannot authorize real-book posting.
Ordered EPS and company-to-EPS records retain incomplete, unsupported and rejected results without silently dropping series or substituting closing shares for weighted shares.
